import sys

def getvisavis(n, i):
    return n - i - 1

def swap(arr, i, j):
    arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    b = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    res = list(s)

    waitingList = set()
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if res[i] == res[getvisavis(n, i)]:
            if not waitingList:
                waitingList.add(i)
            else:
                found = False
                for j in list(waitingList):
                    if res[j] != res[i]:
                        minB1 = j if b[j] < b[getvisavis(n, j)] else getvisavis(n, j)
                        minB2 = i if b[i] < b[getvisavis(n, i)] else getvisavis(n, i)
                        swap(res, minB1, minB2)
                        b[minB1] = 0
                        b[minB2] = 0
                        waitingList.remove(j)
                        found = True
                        break
                if not found:
                    waitingList.add(i)

    w = {}
    w[0] = set()
    for i in range(n):
        if b[i] not in w:
            w[b[i]] = set()
        w[b[i]].add(i)

    for i in range(n // 2):
        if res[i] == res[getvisavis(n, i)]:
            finished = False
            indexToChange = i if b[i] < b[getvisavis(n, i)] else getvisavis(n, i)
            for key in sorted(w.keys()):
                candidates = w[key]
                for j in list(candidates):
                    if j == i or j == indexToChange or res[indexToChange] == res[j] or res[indexToChange] == res[getvisavis(n, j)]:
                        continue
                    swap(res, indexToChange, j)
                    b[j] = 0
                    b[indexToChange] = 0
                    w[0].add(j)
                    w[0].add(indexToChange)
                    w[b[indexToChange]].remove(indexToChange)
                    w[b[j]].remove(j)
                    finished = True
                    break
                if finished:
                    break
            if res[i] == res[getvisavis(n, i)]:
                print("alarma")

    for i in range(n // 2):
        if res[i] == res[getvisavis(n, i)]:
            print("FFFF")

    total = sum(b)
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
